newsitem.title: UK: Great Portland leads sector lower.
newsitem.headline: Great Portland leads sector lower.

text.p: Shares in Great Portland Estates Plc led the UK property Sector lower on Tuesday after the company set a four-for-25 rights issue, dealers said.
By 1300 GMT, Great Portland shares were down 7-1/2p to 208.
The property development group said it was offering new ordinary shares at 190p.
"It's depressing the whole sector," said one dealer, referring to the rights issue.
However, the sector rallied sharply during the fourth quarter and some said it was merely taking a breather.
Shares in MEPC Plc eased 9-1/2p to 445-1/2, under the additional weight of negative comments from brokerage ABN Amro Hoare Govett, dealers said.
Among others in the sector, shares in British Land Co stumbled 15-1/2p to 504-1/2, while shares in Slough Estates Plc fell 7-1/2p to 277-1/2. Shares in Land Securities Plc slipped 5-1/2p to 762.
